name: diffctx
description: Selects the minimum code an LLM needs to review a git diff

impact_hook.title: Impact before commit, merge and push
impact_hook.description: Before git commit/merge/cherry-pick/push or a PR, and after a git diff or git status, show what the pending change reaches outside the diff (once per change, never blocks)

impact_gate.title: Strict gate: no commit before its impact was reviewed
impact_gate.description: Deny git commit/merge/push until the change's impact has been shown once (by the hook, a manual --mode impact run, or the /diffctx:impact skill); the retry passes. Fixing a caller changes the content, so the next attempt is denied once more with the new impact.
